title: W/'S WIPER ACCESS DOOR & VENT GRILLE
summary: Windshield wiper access door (the vacuum-operated wiper door / wiper cover panel at the rear of the hood) and the cowl vent grille panel, all models. The grille panel [6] is screwed down onto the mounting pads on the cowl with screws [2]; the access door panel [1] pivots on the door control linkage at each end, attached with bolt [5], washer [4] and bushings [3]. Related sheets: D3 (control linkage), D4 (actuator and limit switch).

parts.name: PANEL ASM. - ACCESS DR.
parts.name_expanded: Panel assembly – wiper access door (wiper door)

fastening.to: mounting pads on the cowl (left, center, right)
fastening.note: Screws [2] go down through the grille panel [6] flange into the cowl pads; dashed lines show two holes at each of three pads.

fastening.to: access door control linkage arm at the door end
fastening.note: Right end shown: bolt [5] with washer [4] passes through bushings [3] in the linkage arm into the access door [1] end bracket.

notes_internal: Torque legend triangles 1-5 are blank (no values printed), although triangles 1 and 2 are tagged on [2] and [5].
Only the RH end of the door pivot is detailed; LH end assumed similar but not shown.
Margin stamp 'K76' near the title block. No revisions.
